The '''Martano estate''' was an estate belonging to the wealthy gambler [[Tierce Martano]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was located in a [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] region on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] and was built in a [[Classical Naboo style/Legends|Classical Naboo style]].<ref name="SWG:WYG" />

==History==
{{Quote|Those blasted Black Sun dare to trap me in my own vacation estate!|[[Tierce Martano]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:WYG" />}}
[[File:MartanoEstate2.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Black Sun enforcers besieging the Martano estate.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] by the name [[Cal Handro]], an old [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] friend of Tierce Martano, arrived at the Martano estate after a long walk in the wilderness.<ref name="SWG:WYG" /> The man was tracked down by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] because he was transporting a new kind of [[Syren spice|spice]].<ref name="SWG:MtYBF">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other}}Quest: "More than You Bargained For"</ref> The gambler accepted to give him shelter but the Black Sun soon discovered the presence of Cal Handro at the estate and besieged the building. In order to get rid of the Black Sun, Martano contacted both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to negotiate information about the pilot's location. However, before he could get an answer, a fight erupted between the Black Sun henchmen and a group of spacer who were also searching for the missing pilot. Martano was rescued by the spacers who eliminated all Black Sun forces. As the gambler wished to get rid of Handro as soon as possible, he eagerly accepted to give the location of Handro to the spacers.<ref name="SWG:WYG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Martano estate was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:WYG" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Martano estate was added to the game with the fourth chapter of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" quest line, released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> The "Secrets of the Syren" story arc was removed from the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]], due to the major changes planed for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>
